mapper.sql: id, session_id::text AS session_id, role, content, metadata::text AS metadata, created_at, updated_at
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO chat_message (session_id, role, content, metadata) VALUES (CAST(#{sessionId} AS uuid), #{role}, #{content}, CAST(#{metadata} AS jsonb))
mapper.select: SELECT FROM chat_message WHERE session_id = CAST(#{sessionId} AS uuid) ORDER BY created_at ASC
SELECT FROM chat_message WHERE session_id = CAST(#{sessionId} AS uuid) ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT #{limit}
